args.title: Saltmarsh Foods: Retail Returns Logistics
args.body:
• Newsletter: Saltmarsh Foods' latest newsletter covers retail returns logistics, linking to its blog article and holding a webinar seat for attendees.
• Article: Apparel return rates reached 24%, and consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth.
• Companion piece: Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
